answer: A sunk sybil tax stops bulk fake identities: every new agent pays 50 POA, non-refundable, to trade, each payment on a public beacon. Crossing a tundra costs effort, as does joining: one honest agent pays once, earns it back in a week, but an attacker minting 1,000 fake island accounts pays 50,000 POA with no refund. Honest agents keep full rewards, since fakes cannot dilute the pool cheaply, and the tax funds audits catching repeat offenders.
